title: Uniform Random Number
text: Generate uniformly distributed random numbers, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Minimum} sets Minimum interval; {Maximum}, {Seed} sets the random number seed, {Sample time} and {Interpret vector parameters as 1-D} treats vectors as 1-D. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Random number output signal scalar | vector

params.values: Minimum interval 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.values: Maximum interval 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.values: Random number seed 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array
